id.description: Present on the materialised object. MUST be absent from the create Event payload: zh/models/common-fields.md derives it from the create Event's own event_id (retyped), so a payload-supplied id would be a second, forgeable truth.

actor_kind.description: Closed Actor classification. agent is reserved exclusively for a controller-provisioned Agent; Applet-created or Applet-hosted automation uses bot; Ghost Actor is provenance rather than an actor_kind and uses integration for an external account/integration mirror or bot for an external bot mirror. MUST NOT include device: a device is an endpoint rather than an Actor principal. actor_kind alone grants no authority; authorization still requires the normative DID, provisioning/registration, Grant and Constraint evidence. See zh/models/actor.md.

handle.description: Arkret canonical handle string: <localpart>:<domain>. The @ mention sigil is not part of the handle.

agent_slug.description: Projection hint for a controller-scoped selector slug backed by ak.schema.agent_selector_claim.v1. Only valid when actor_kind=agent under ak.profile.agent_provisioning.v1; it is not a global handle and MUST NOT be used for authorization, attribution, or Directory discovery. The mention input token @<controller-handle>/<agent_slug> resolves to this actor's principal_id before persistence only after selector claim validation.

status.description: Public projection of the AccountStatusRecord lifecycle values defined in zh/identity/account-lifecycle.md §3. Implementations MAY hide or coarsen this field in projection views.

resolution.description: Read-only current principal did projection derived from the PCR identity resolution cell. It is not writable through Actor Profile create/update patches and is not an authorization root.
